exposure: Controls: Newborns with gestational age greater than 37 weeks
Cases: Newborns with gestational age between 34 and 36 weeks and 6 days old
finding: Late premature infants had a higher probability of requiring resuscitation, being born by cesarean section, and having mothers with morbidity, specifically hypertensive disorders.
mod_finding: Late premature infants were 4.17 times more likely to be born by cesarean section.
